caption: A red billiard ball rolls into a stationary blue billiard ball; after contact, the blue ball moves away while the red ball slows.

clauses.text: The red billiard ball must be in motion and approaching the stationary blue billiard ball.
The blue billiard ball must remain stationary until contacted by the red ball.
After contact, the blue billiard ball must visibly move away from the point of impact.
After contact, the red billiard ball must visibly slow down as it continues moving.
